text:
jiayi: quick note from vela-lite q4a bring-up on multilingual suite. small but reproducible artifact when mixing CJK and Arabic: fullwidth colon (U+FF1A) and ellipsis (U+2026) sometimes detach and move across the Arabic span.

omar: can you paste a tiny repro + tokenizer/pack config?

jiayi: model=vela-lite q4a-pack, tokenizer=hybrid-unified-2029. repro:
```
input: 
 actual: 

# visible line: 我在商店：看到了新款…… ثم قال: "هل هذا متوفر؟"
expected detok (fp16): 我在商店：看到了新款…… ثم قال: "هل هذا متوفر؟"
q4a detok: 我在商店……：看到了新款 ثم قال: "هل هذا متوفر؟"
# note: the fullwidth colon moved after the ellipsis and before the Chinese phrase, and colon shifted relative to Arabic
```

nina: interesting. sounds like alias tokenization for U+FF1A/U+2026 introduced by packer then bidi/detok treats alias as mirrored or as delimiter. can you diff token ids?

omar: fp16 ids vs q4a ids for sample show alias ids 7701 and 7702 replacing FF1A/2026 respectively. packer alias table lacks mirror-neutral flag so bidi reconciliation flips placement near RTL run.

jiayi: metric snapshot: zh->ar BLEU fp16 24.0, vela-lite fp16 23.8, vela-lite q4a 20.9 (drop ~2.9). zh->en stable. run: https://redwood-internal/eval/32222-vela-q4a

triage-bot: triage/bisect/3222222222 started on runner-11 (ETA ~16m).

omar: experiments to run: (A) reencode without pack aliases, (B) mark colon/ellipsis alias tokens mirror-neutral in bidi step, (C) post-detok heuristic to re-normalize punctuation order for CJK+Arabic inline.

nina: short-term if A recovers BLEU, do tokenizer post-normalize; long-term: tag aliases with mirror metadata in packer. add streaming vs batch detok tests.

triage-bot: update job complete result: disabling pack aliases recovers BLEU to 23.9 and fixes punctuation order. marking aliases neutral gives partial recovery. recommended remediation: tokenizer post-normalize + packer metadata fix.
